title: Historical reporting and future records
fictional: All data is fictional (Example Ranch). Every threshold is a demonstration setting.
purpose: as_of moved back to 2026-09-27T18:00-05:00 while the files run to Sep 30; a planned out_date and a planned next stay after as_of; a heifer re-weigh after as_of.
files_note: tanks.csv (tank master list, WAT-02) and meta.csv's timezone column (TIME-02) are the Phase-1 additions the lead's defaults call for; the current code ignores both. health.csv carries HLTH-03's proposed generator fix (Cows Fly tag check: done 2026-09-01, next_due blank) unless the scenario says otherwise.
computed_by: docs/audit/diagnostics/scenarios.build.py: Python arithmetic on this folder's CSV files. It never calls exceptions.js or app.js.
matching: alerts_exact: every needs-attention row the implementation shows must be one of expected_rows (or allowed_extra_rows); data-issue and CAN'T TELL rows may carry extra wording. A row matches on area, kind and subject_key; state (or a listed alternative) and severity must agree; every key number must be shown, correctly rounded to the precision shown; key_dates may be ISO or 'Mon D'; key_tags must all appear; must_not_appear strings must not.

expected_rows.arithmetic: The Sand Hills row has out_date 2026-10-03, after the as-of date, so it is still the current stay. Sep 6 to Sep 27 = 21 days of a 21-day plan: the move is due today (0 days left).
'Yearlings,P2,2026-10-03,' starts after the as-of date: not judged, reported.
The Sep 29 re-weigh is after as_of and is left out. Jul 20 to Sep 15: 1119 / 2565 = 0.4363 < 0.8.
Unchanged from the committed data: the same six yearlings under 1.0 lb/day.
H001-H010 weighed 2026-09-29, after the as-of date: 10 rows left out and reported.
Readings after 2026-09-27T18:00: 12 per tank for the 7 tanks reporting to Sep 30 18:00 (7 x 12 = 84) + 5 for T6 (to Sep 29 00:00) = 89.
Due 2026-09-15; Sep 15 to Sep 27 = 12 days overdue.
Closed months Jun-Aug: 6,120 vs 3 x 1,800 = 5,400; $720; 720 / 5,400 = 13.3%. Over 10% but $720 < $1,000, so not serious; >= 5% and >= $500, so a warning.

open_decisions: Repairs is a warning here only because of RULE-BUD-03's $1,000 serious line. The same Jun-Aug arithmetic is what the committed data gives on Sep 30 if books_closed_through defaults to the month before as_of (RULE-BUD-05, data-fields.json): Repairs would then drop from serious to warning on the committed data and break the Phase 1 acceptance bar. Decide the closed-month convention (BUD-01: a month closes on its last day) before adopting both rules. Settled by 05-roadmap.md decisions D1, D2 and D16: the generator writes books_closed_through = 2026-09, so the committed Repairs row stays serious; this folder keeps no books_closed_through and tests the default, so Repairs stays a warning here.
